title: Versions document
description: The versions.json document at artifacts/<namespace>/<kind>/<name>/versions.json. One entry per published version. This document is authoritative for status and yanked; everything else about a version is immutable. File spec section 3.3.

latest.description: The version a bare ref resolves to. MUST be listed in versions[] and, when any version is active and not yanked, MUST be the newest of those (file spec section 3.3). Both rules are checked by the checker, not by this schema.

versions.description: Entries SHOULD be ordered newest first.

digest.description: Content digest, file spec section 4.2. Never changes; a lockfile pins it.

catalog_digest.description: Digest over the content digest plus mutable catalog state, file spec section 4.3. Moves on a status change or a yank.

yanked.description: True when the version must not be selected by range resolution. Bytes remain resolvable to a pinned digest.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the current status or yank.
